title: The encrypted session envelope, annotated
focus: A walk-through of the v1 envelope format and the reasoning behind each choice - AES-256-GCM over CBC, per-file random salt+IV, scrypt with N=16384/r=8/p=1 instead of PBKDF2, the KDF-param bounds check, the derived-key cache keyed by (passphrase, salt, params), and the write-side rule that prevents toggling encryptionEnabled from quietly rewriting an encrypted session in plaintext.
